# Skill attribution boundary

Skills from `tikoci/routeros-skills` are supplemental, not authoritative.

- Keep provenance headers when skills are exposed through MCP resources or the TUI.
- Do not blur skill guidance together with official MikroTik docs in wording or ranking.
- When documenting the corpus, call out that skills are AI-generated, human-reviewed, and should be verified against official docs.
